4. 排除根节点本身
code_python3:
class Solution:
    def checkEqualTree(self, root: Optional[TreeNode]) -> bool:
        sums = []
        def dfs(node):
            if not node: return 0
            s = node.val + dfs(node.left) + dfs(node.right)
            sums.append(s)
            return s
        total = dfs(root)
        sums.pop()  # remove root
        return total % 2 == 0 and total // 2 in sums

class Solution:

title: Maximum Sum of 3 Non-Overlapping Subarrays
key_insight: 用前缀和预处理子数组和，然后用left和right数组记录最优位置
approach:
1. 计算所有长度为k的子数组和
2. left[i]记录0..i中最大子数组和的起始位置
3. right[i]记录i..n-1中最大子数组和的起始位置
4. 枚举中间子数组位置
code_python3:
class Solution:
    def maxSumOfThreeSubarrays(self, nums, k):
        n = len(nums)
        sums = [0]*(n-k+1)
        s = sum(nums[:k])
        sums[0] = s
        for i in range(1, n-k+1):
            s += nums[i+k-1] - nums[i-1]
            sums[i] = s
        left = [0]*(n-k+1)
        best = 0
        for i in range(n-k+1):
            if sums[i] > sums[best]: best = i
            left[i] = best
        right = [0]*(n-k+1)
        best = n-k
        for i in range(n-k, -1, -1):
            if sums[i] >= sums[best]: best = i
            right[i] = best
        ans = None
        for j in range(k, n-2*k+1):
            i, l = left[j-k], right[j+k]
            total = sums[i]+sums[j]+sums[l]
            if ans is None or total > ans[0]:
                ans = (total, [i, j, l])
        return ans[1]

code_python3:
class Solution:
    def search(self, reader, target):
        hi = 1
        while reader.get(hi) < target: hi *= 2
        lo = hi // 2
        while lo <= hi:
            mid = (lo+hi)//2
            val = reader.get(mid)
            if val == target: return mid
            elif val < target: lo = mid+1
            else: hi = mid-1
        return -1
